title: Koshari: Rice and Lentil Pilaf
subtitle: with fine noodles, pine nuts and parsley
description: Green lentils are folded through spiced basmati rice cooked with toasted vermicelli, then finished with toasted pine nuts and parsley. This version skips the usual tomato sauce.

steps.text: Put the lentils in a large pot, cover with plenty of water, bring to the boil and cook over medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes until tender but not falling apart. Drain and dry slightly.

Boil water in a kettle. Heat the olive oil in a large pot and fry the vermicelli for about 2 minutes until it begins to turn golden and slightly brown, watching so it does not burn. Add the rice and stir well.

Add the salt, cinnamon, pepper, cloves and 1 1/2 cups of boiling water and stir. Bring to the boil, cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Turn off the heat, fluff with a fork, lay a clean thick tea towel over the pot, close the lid on the towel and rest for at least 10 minutes.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan until lightly golden.
Gently stir the lentils into the rice, then add the pine nuts and parsley and stir again. Taste and add salt if needed.
